chromium.optionalDescription: Renderizado HTML/Markdown/RST a PNG/TIFF mediante Chromium opcional versionado.

issues.description: Quick Converter DOCX→PNG preserved only target, so Markdown could be accepted and converted as MD→PNG.
issues.impact: User intent is violated; product can return a successful result for the wrong selected source.
issues.root: Desktop shell stored selectedTarget but not selectedSource.
issues.recommendation: Preserve source+target pair; restrict picker/drop; validate detected source before capability selection.

issues.impact: Refresh/deep link/share workflows fail; release criterion for direct URL is not met.
issues.root: Top navigation is local React state on / only; no route pages or URL state sync.
issues.recommendation: Add route-backed pages or URL query/hash state for top-level tabs and selected conversion.
issues.verification: Closed in final UX remediation: /convert, /history and /diagnostics return 200 in production and dev; refresh keeps page content and active nav.

issues.description: Image-only/scanned-like PDF→DOCX fails with generic engine execution message instead of explaining OCR requirement.
issues.impact: User cannot understand that OCR is needed for editable text.
issues.root: PDF analysis does not classify scanned/image-only content for the normal conversion flow.
issues.recommendation: Detect scanned PDFs before conversion and route to OCR-specific UX/actionable copy.
issues.verification: Closed in final UX remediation: scanned-like PDF to DOCX returns OCR guidance and unit coverage asserts SCANNED_CONTENT_REQUIRES_OCR with no fallback.

issues.description: Chromium installable state is represented in capabilities/diagnostics, but no minimal install/confirmation UI was found in the conversion flow.
issues.impact: On machines without Chromium pack, MD/HTML/RST→PNG/TIFF is discoverable only as a missing component path, not a complete product flow.
issues.root: Runtime pack architecture exists; product install action is not wired into normal converter.
issues.recommendation: Add a small required-component panel: component name, purpose, approximate size, install-once, confirm/progress/error/success.
issues.verification: Closed in final UX remediation: isolated missing-pack runtime shows install UI with product name, manifest size, consent and cancel; backend remains gated with 428 until install.

issues.description: Source-only Continue opens unfiltered Convert Hub and loses the chosen source.
issues.impact: Source-first discovery is less predictable; user must re-discover targets.
issues.root: Quick Converter source-only path calls onOpenConvert without source context.
issues.recommendation: Preserve source in hub state and filter target cards to effective targets.

issues.description: History default cards expose engine/loss metadata such as LibreOffice, Poppler and risk badges.
issues.impact: Internal architecture leaks into a normal system page.
issues.root: History renders technical badges by default for universal jobs.
issues.recommendation: Move engine/loss details behind an optional details disclosure; keep default to filename, source, target, status, date, duration/download.

issues.description: Conversion route summary shows intermediate segments like DOCX→PDF→PNG in the normal flow.
issues.impact: Normal users see implementation mechanics before conversion.
issues.root: Route summary component optimizes for technical transparency rather than product simplicity.
issues.recommendation: Default to concise copy such as “Convirtiendo a PNG”; keep route details collapsed under technical details.

issues.description: pnpm start serves successfully but Next warns that standalone output should run via node .next/standalone/server.js.
issues.impact: Release/start instructions can diverge from the built output mode.
issues.root: next.config uses output: standalone while package start uses next start.
issues.recommendation: Add a production start script for standalone or adjust release runbook.

issues.description: next build passes with Turbopack NFT tracing warnings for API routes.
issues.impact: No observed runtime failure, but noisy release signal.
issues.root: Dynamic fs/config imports trace broad project paths.
issues.recommendation: Review trace roots or add targeted Turbopack ignore/static scoping later.

issues.description: Diagnostics shows shell commands and Windows/Linux setup helper in the main diagnostics view.
issues.impact: Acceptable for diagnostics, but can feel more technical than the product principle wants.
issues.root: Diagnostics combines user status and install/runbook details.
issues.recommendation: Keep status first; move command snippets into “Advanced install help”.
